title: Optimal bounds for the ratio of differences of quadratic, arithmetic, and harmonic means
summary: We determine the optimal constants in inequalities comparing the differences of the quadratic, arithmetic, and harmonic means of $n$ nonnegative real numbers. Specifically, we prove that for $n\ge3$ the sharp double inequality \[ \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}\le \frac{A_n-H_n}{Q_n-H_n}\le \sqrt{\frac{n-1}{n}} \] holds true. This extends earlier results by T. Mitev, which established the sharp bounds only for the cases $n=3,4,$ and $5$.
